provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Ticket to Ride: Europe rules (Days of Wonder, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Each player: 45 Train Cars, 3 Train Stations and a Scoring Marker on Start
Shuffle the Train cards and deal {n} each; turn 5 faceup by the deck
European Express Bonus and Summary card faceup by the board
Shuffle the 6 long routes (blue background) and deal 1 each; box the rest unseen
Shuffle the regular Destination Tickets and deal 3 each
Before the first turn everyone keeps at least 2 of their tickets; discards go back in the box unseen
